summary_ja: 調整項目の額について、適用日から5年間、第5条第1項の表の率を乗じた額を各資本区分の調整項目に算入でき、残余の取扱いを定める。
summary_en: For five years from the Application Date, allows adjustment-item amounts to be recognized at the percentages in the table of Article 5 of the Supplementary Provisions, and assigns the remainder to Additional Tier 1, Tier 2 or the former rules.
paragraphs: With respect to the amounts listed in Article 5, paragraph (2), items (i) through (vi), Article 6, paragraph (2), items (i) through (iv) and the items of Article 7, paragraph (2) of the Public Notice, until the date five years have elapsed from the Application Date, the amounts obtained by multiplying those amounts by the rate set out in the right-hand column of the table in Article 5, paragraph (1) of the Supplementary Provisions, according to the period category set out in the left-hand column of that table, may be included, respectively, in the amount of adjustment items relating to Common Equity Tier 1 Capital in the formula of Article 2, item (i) of the Public Notice, the amount of adjustment items relating to Additional Tier 1 Capital in the formula of item (ii) of that Article, or the amount of adjustment items relating to Tier 2 Capital in the formula of item (iii) of that Article.

Of the amounts listed in Article 5, paragraph (2), items (i) through (vi), Article 6, paragraph (2), items (i) through (iv) and the items of Article 7, paragraph (2) of the Public Notice, with respect to the amount of the portion other than the portion corresponding to the amount included, under the preceding paragraph, in the amount of adjustment items relating to Common Equity Tier 1 Capital in the formula of Article 2, item (i) of the Public Notice, the amount of adjustment items relating to Additional Tier 1 Capital in the formula of item (ii) of that Article, or the amount of adjustment items relating to Tier 2 Capital in the formula of item (iii) of that Article: the amount of the portion of that amount that falls under the basic items in the formula of Article 3 of the Former Public Notice shall be included in the amount of adjustment items relating to Additional Tier 1 Capital in the formula of Article 2, item (ii) of the Public Notice; the amount of the portion that falls under the supplementary items or deduction items in the formula of Article 3 of the Former Public Notice shall be included in the amount of adjustment items relating to Tier 2 Capital in the formula of Article 2, item (iii) of the Public Notice; and the amount of the portion that falls under none of the basic items, supplementary items and deduction items in the formula of Article 3 of the Former Public Notice shall remain subject to the previous practice.
